recollections.text: I was laying the reading-room table before the lamps were lowered.
Tobin Hale picks up the lamp base.
Tobin Hale strikes Oren Dutt with the heavy lamp base. Oren Dutt falls and does not respond.
Maren Vale arrives from Pine Lantern side hall.
